text:
Many products, from phones to cosmetics, arrive in boxes that are larger than the item and filled with plastic, paper and foam. I agree that much product packaging is wasteful and unnecessary, although some of it has a genuine purpose.

To begin with, a great deal of packaging exists mainly for marketing rather than protection. Attractive boxes, extra layers and oversized containers make products look more valuable, but they are discarded as soon as the item is opened. Online shopping adds more waste, as a small object may be sent in a large box filled with padding. A small bottle of perfume inside a box, a plastic case and a wrapping film, for example, uses far more material than the product needs. When millions of items are sold, this excess becomes a mountain of rubbish that councils must collect and dispose of.

Furthermore, this extra material has real costs for the environment. Making packaging consumes energy, water and raw materials, and much of it ends up in landfill or is burned, because mixed materials are hard to recycle. Larger boxes also take up more space in lorries, so more trips are needed to deliver the same goods. However, some packaging is necessary: fragile items such as glass or electronics need protection, and safe packaging prevents damage that would waste the product itself. The sensible answer is therefore not to abolish packaging but to design it better, using the smallest suitable size and materials that can be recycled. Governments could encourage this through standards and by making producers pay for the waste they create.

In conclusion, I agree that much product packaging is wasteful and unnecessary, but with better design and clear rules the problem can be reduced.

plan.step: 3. Lý do 2 — chi phí môi trường + nhượng bộ
plan.think: Sản xuất tốn năng lượng, nước, nguyên liệu; vật liệu hỗn hợp khó tái chế; hộp lớn khiến xe tải cần thêm chuyến. Nhượng bộ: hàng dễ vỡ cần bảo vệ; giải pháp là thiết kế tốt hơn và buộc nhà sản xuất trả phí.
Đồng ý, nhưng thiết kế tốt và luật rõ ràng có thể giảm vấn đề.
